desktop_auth_requests_device_check.name: desktop_auth_requests_device_check
desktop_auth_requests_device_check.value:
("desktop_auth_requests"."device_kind" is null and "desktop_auth_requests"."device_platform" is null and "desktop_auth_requests"."device_name" is null and "desktop_auth_requests"."device_client_version" is null)
        or ("desktop_auth_requests"."device_kind" in ('browser_extension', 'desktop_agent')
          and "desktop_auth_requests"."device_platform" in ('chrome', 'edge', 'firefox', 'windows', 'macos', 'linux')
          and char_length("desktop_auth_requests"."device_name") between 1 and 64
          and char_length("desktop_auth_requests"."device_client_version") between 1 and 32)
